# Where to find Kaleidopore Flowers and how to make Formula P in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jan 17, 2024
- 3 min read

Updated: Feb 12, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_457ccbd4f5cc449a8417ac69021fb8de~mv2.png)

Dedicated to Aux, farm your own Kaleidopore Flowers :p

Used for:

**Formula P**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b9b4ae0bef7f4db5a780c77b17e525d7~mv2.jpg)

Formula P is a chem that provides +5 Charisma, +3 Luck, and improves gun accuracy for 5 minutes.

Formula P can only be crafted or purchased from/traded with other players. There are no fixed spawns or NPCs that sell Formula P in game.

Ingredients required to make 1x Formula P

- Kaleidopore Flower x 2
- Ash Rose x 2
- Bloodleaf x 1
- Antiseptic x 1

### **__Farming Tips and Tricks__**

__Farming Tips and Tricks__

The following perk cards, magazines, and/or backpack mods will increase your yields.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b757502e91e64ba18357aaacecb4e8a5~mv2.png)

Don't forget to equip Chemist and Super Duper perk card when crafting Formula P.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cca10fd6134240158590f9d0a0f1cb72~mv2.png)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6edc84f860344f089f225706d83f767b~mv2.jpg)

__Formula P plan__

The recipe can be awarded upon completing the __Project Paradise__ event. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c4174bb91b4f47ffb89a00aa8f2f01e3~mv2.jpg)

The chance is dependent on the surviving creatures as follows:

- 14.29% with three creatures alive and if the Bear Arm plan has been learned
- 16.67% with three creatures alive and if the Bear Arm plan has not been learned
- 18.75% with two creatures alive
- 16.67% with one creature alive

The plan is tradeable so sometimes you can find copies in player's vendors or you can trade for a copy of the plan.

**Antiseptic**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9b0e49356e0648b794d9a9af198797c1~mv2.jpg)

Can be found in:

- Abraxo Cleaner x2
- Abraxo Cleaner Industrial Grade x3
- Autopsy Board Game x1
- Blood Sac x2
- Empty Blood Sac x2
- Industrial Solvent x3
- Royal Jelly (junk item) x3
- Tick Blood Sac x2
- Toothpaste x1
- Turpentine x2
- Undamaged Abraxo Cleaner x2
- Waste Antiseptic x1

__Ash Rose__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d42b61af5025401baf004d065aadc364~mv2.jpg)

**Bloodleaf**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_de71a869889741e3962844b14b942fce~mv2.jpg)

Bloodleaf can be found anywhere that there is water.

Suggested Locations:

- Fast Travel to Lewis & Son's Farming Supply. Cross the road so you are on the river bank and then follow the river bank all the way up to Billings Homestead. This is also a good route for Mirelurk Eggs and Snaptail Reeds. Cross over to Billings and Silva Homestead for some more Ash Rose plants.

- Fast Travel to the Wayward. Start at the back of the Wayward and walk down the river towards Vault Tech Agricultural Centre. Plenty of Bloodleaf and Snaptail Reeds to be found and harvested. Speak to the NPC's that spawn along the way. Depending on your answer they will gift you magazines that count towards your atom challenges.

- Fast Travel to Hillfolk Hotdogs. Follow the river bank up towards Sunshine Meadows Industrial Farm for some more Bloodleaf. Speak to the NPC's that spawn along the way as some of them can spawn as Camp Allies.
